name: Urea CO2 stripper
description: High-pressure column that strips unconverted carbamate from the urea solution using feed CO2 as the stripping agent, decomposing carbamate and returning ammonia and CO2 to the condenser. CO2 stripping cut the steam demand of urea plants relative to conventional total-recycle designs. Primary source: https://patents.google.com/patent/WO2017097981A1/en
applications: urea synthesis, high-pressure loop carbamate recovery

specifications.basis: urea hydrolyses back to ammonium carbamate in hottest stages, especially the stripper, so residence times there are designed to be short
